sections.text: Postponed Reward is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Well, you fucked up with the evidence in a very embarrassing way, but sure, I'll keep my word. I'll get you your fucking container. But now I'm gonna ask you for something else, since things got so ugly."
